prompt:
A tall man seen from the waist up at a municipal information counter, vertical
framing. He is the ONLY person in the frame: no one else is visible, no shoulder,
arm or head of another person in the foreground or at the edges, nothing between
him and the camera. He stands three quarters to camera, turned slightly to his
right, looking at someone off screen to the RIGHT of frame, never at the camera. He wears a light blue button-down
shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm and navy trousers with a brown
leather belt. The front edge of a worn wooden counter crosses the lower part of
the frame. Behind him, the pale mint-green wall of the waiting hall with its
darker green dado rail, and the room falling away out of focus. Mixed daylight
and fluorescent light, the same light as the waiting hall. Documentary realism.

Use the reference images for the man only - his face, his height, his build and
his hair - and for the counter and the wall, and NOT for the framing.
